            r'--',
            r'/\*.*\*/',
            r'\bOR\b\s+[\'\"]?\d+[\'\"]?\s*=\s*[\'\"]?\d+',
            r'\bOR\b\s+1\s*=\s*1',
        ]
        
        for pattern in dangerous_patterns:

            sql = sql[:-1].strip()
